name: @crvouga/sqlite-mem
description: Pure TypeScript in-memory SQLite implementation with zero WASM/native dependencies

scripts.test:fuzz:soak: SQLITE_MEM_MIXED_STEPS=${SQLITE_MEM_MIXED_STEPS:-48} SQLITE_MEM_STATEFUL_STEPS=${SQLITE_MEM_STATEFUL_STEPS:-48} SQLITE_MEM_WALK_STEPS=${SQLITE_MEM_WALK_STEPS:-48} SQLITE_MEM_FUZZ_RUNS=${SQLITE_MEM_FUZZ_RUNS:-40} bun test tests/fuzz/mixed-stateful.test.ts tests/fuzz/stateful.test.ts tests/fuzz/random-walk.test.ts tests/fuzz/metamorphic tests/fuzz/robustness.test.ts tests/fuzz/sqllogictest.test.ts tests/fuzz/corpus.test.ts
scripts.test:dst: bun test tests/fuzz/stateful.test.ts tests/fuzz/mixed-stateful.test.ts tests/fuzz/random-walk.test.ts tests/fuzz/corpus.test.ts
scripts.benchmark:compare: bun run benchmarks/run.ts --tier default --engine compare --grep compare/ --out benchmarks/results/compare-js.json
scripts.benchmark:compare-js: bun run benchmarks/run.ts --tier default --engine compare-js --grep compare/js/ --out benchmarks/results/compare-js-only.json
scripts.benchmark:compare-sqlite: bun run benchmarks/run.ts --tier default --engine compare-sqlite --grep compare/sqlite/ --out benchmarks/results/compare-sqlite.json
scripts.benchmark:ci: bun run benchmarks/run.ts --tier ci --engine mem --out benchmarks/results/ci-latest.json && bun run benchmarks/compare-ci.ts && bun run benchmarks/check-budgets.ts
scripts.benchmark:bundle: bun run build && bun run benchmarks/bundle.ts
scripts.test:browser: bun run build && bun run scripts/browser-perf.ts
scripts.test:browser-sql: bun run build && bun run scripts/browser-sql-smoke.ts
scripts.test:sqlite-compat: bun run scripts/sqlite-compat-gate.ts && bun run scripts/check-skip-register.ts && bun test tests/contract tests/fuzz tests/harness
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:sqlite-compat
scripts.secrets:check: bun run scripts/secrets/check-vault.ts && bun run scripts/secrets/check-github.ts
scripts.example:react-vite: cd examples/react-vite && bun install && bun run dev
